title: Canonical Hom adjoints of a rational Verdier evaluation
statement: For every normalized RationalVerdier.Datum A and every full Hom-domain witness h, there is a natural isomorphism e from A.dual to the specified rational internal Hom into the localized omega. The Hom-first transpose of the swapped A.evaluation is e; the transpose of A.evaluation is A.bidual followed by e at A.dual(K). These are equations for the recorded evaluation and bidual arrows.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1–3; explicit interface extracted from lem-coef-rational-retract-evaluation

proof.text: Compare the ordinary counit in A with the integral closed presentation. Precomposition with the invertible ordinary-to-completed comparison identifies the two completed evaluations. The normalized rational transpose is the localization of the integral one, so it has the same evaluation. Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies the dual functors by a natural isomorphism e and yields the first transpose equation.

The integral bidual in A is defined by transposing evaluation after the recorded signed symmetry. Its normalization and the pure-tensor localization formulas identify the second rational transpose with A.bidual followed by e at the dual object. Both formulas are independent of proposition-valued Hom-domain witnesses.

lean.statement: theorem rationalVerdier_evaluation_adjoints (h : ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X, constructibleRationalHomPairs l E X (op K, M)) (w : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E) (A : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl X E w) : ∃ e : A.dual ≅ RationalOperations.homDual l E X h ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj w.omega), ∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X, ((@podRationalClosed l _ E _ _ _ X (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X)).transpose (A.dual.obj (op K)) ⟨(op K, (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj w.omega), h K _⟩ ((@pullbackTensorRationalBraiding l _ E _ _ _ X (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (A.dual.obj (op K)) K).hom ≫ A.evaluation K) = e.hom.app (op K)) ∧ ((@podRationalClosed l _ E _ _ _ X (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X)).transpose K ⟨(op (A.dual.obj (op K)), (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj w.omega), h _ _⟩ (A.evaluation K) = A.bidual.hom.app K ≫ e.hom.app (op (A.dual.obj (op K))))
